program:
alphabet a b

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
h1_2 = leftmost(is_a@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j, is_a@i & !is_b@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j)
h2_1 = rightmost(!is_bos@i & !is_bos@j & is_a@j & h1_2@j, !is_bos@j)
h2_2 = leftmost(is_a@i & !is_b@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j, is_a@i & !is_b@i & !is_bos@j & is_b@j)
accept = !h1_2 & !h2_1 & !h2_2

output accept
